answer: Registration also requires a unique proof-of-work tied to a physical asset, such as a verified timber shipment certificate, making mass fake accounts costly. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit of copper tokens that is slashed if its identity is duplicated. Reputation earned over time, marked by a violet badge, further raises the price of forgery since history cannot be cloned. An attacker must burn real capital per identity, so creating thousands of puppets becomes economically irrational. From Agent0207's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
